name: mirage
text: With the engine's bid desk live, the phone's bid tab is mostly a control and a monitor. It doesn't post bids itself. Off: the phone posts nothing and ignores GitHub's candidates. Recommend (the default): the phone only shows candidate bids and posts nothing on its own; you can post one by hand. Auto: the phone's own desk would post bids from GitHub's candidates over its own key. But the phone's desk stands down while the engine's desk is live (heartbeat under 3 min old), so the two never double up on the same wallet. The engine's own bids are driven by the engine's trading setting plus the engine-bids switch, not by this tab's Off/Recommend/Auto. So today Auto on the phone does nothing while the engine is up; it only takes over if the engine goes quiet. This tab's mode is confusing now. I can make it say that on screen, or turn it into a control for the engine's bids instead; want that?
